connector.name: AgentPing
connector.registryDescription: Let your AI agent notify you by email, Slack, Discord, or webhook. One tool: send_notification.
connector.summary: Hosted at ping.mgm-llc.org over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the noriget account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <api_key> — get a free key at https://ping.mgm-llc.org/signup
